text: 【平安证券互换便利业务落地并开启首批投资 支持资本市场健康稳定发展】为支持资本市场健康稳定发展，中国人民银行于11月3日启动第三批证券、基金、保险公司互换便利（SFISF）操作。本次操作金额1000亿元，采用费率招标方式，31家证券、基金公司参与投标，中标费率为10bp（基点）。截至11月11日，平安证券互换便利业务已顺利落地，完成首笔回购融资交易及第一批买入操作。
text_en: [Ping An Securities' SFISF business implemented and first batch of investments launched to support the healthy and stable development of the capital market] To support the healthy and stable development of the capital market, the People's Bank of China launched the third batch of Securities, Funds, and Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF) operations on November 3. This operation amounted to 100 billion yuan and adopted a rate bidding method; 31 securities and fund companies participated in bidding, and the winning rate was 10bp (basis points). As of November 11, Ping An Securities' SFISF business had been smoothly implemented, completing its first repo financing transaction and the first batch of purchase operations.
